result_event.result: [{"item":"①","light":"🟢","judgment_path":"$.answers.q2_moat.verdict_values.moat.threats","reason":"競爭負向 finding（competitive_share_entrants#0/#1/#2）都在第一條 threat 引用，customer_concentration_credit#0 接進 R5，second-source 空軸也在第四條 threat 交代。"},{"item":"②","light":"🟢","judgment_path":"$.answers.q1_business.reasoning","reason":"bundle 的負向清單沒有 supply_demand_durability 的 finding；判斷仍把供需判為週期性、供給可逆性高，並接進 premortem 第一條與空頭 30% 機率。"},{"item":"③","light":"🟢","judgment_path":"$.counter_evidence.contradictions","reason":"關稅與出口管制（reg_tariff_export#0/#1/#2）已進 threats、R4、trigger 7 與產業態勢三軸；其他結構軸在 bundle 只有計數、沒有負向條目，無從判定漏接。"},{"item":"④","light":"🟢","judgment_path":"$.decision_inputs.market_wrong_reason_given","reason":"市場錯在哪有具體數字（共識營收年增 23% 對管理層口徑可推的 12–16%，以及業外 EPS 當分母）；wait_for_price=true 且裁決觀望，符合規則，觸發條件可驗。"},{"item":"⑤","light":"🟡","judgment_path":"$.answers.q2_moat.verdict_values.moat.threats[3]","reason":"customer_second_source 的三組查詢切題（轉單、自製、分散供應商）；判斷已說明查無資料、護城河少了反面檢驗，不改變 C 級。"},{"item":"⑥","light":"🟢","judgment_path":"$.scenario_inputs","reason":"ROIIC、再投資率與 ROIC 都附算式且可複算；內生上界 5% 對共識 EPS CAGR 約 48% 已在 q3 解釋。Bull/Base 價差實質（10.5 對 6.8），ev5y −13.0%、irr −4.5%、Base 88 元重算皆與 scenario_meta 對得上。"},{"item":"⑦","light":"🟡","judgment_path":"$.answers.q1_business.reasoning","reason":"判斷引用的 3Q26 數字（營收 742.4 億、毛利率 34%、利用率 92%）比 facts 的 latest_quarter_kpis（2Q26）新，不是更舊，但 bundle 內沒有對應 finding 可回溯，屬資料級追溯缺口。"},{"item":"⑧","light":"🟢","judgment_path":"$.counter_evidence.contradictions","reason":"drift_watch 20 欄中有變動的欄位（情境價與不對稱比、最大回撤、現價、重啟條件、循環位置）都有帶 cause 的條目或程式歸因；裁決與前份同為觀望，QC-49 不需承繼。"}]
